expectation_policy: Expected values, native units and obligations remain the independent sealed design; no custom expected values are emitted. Public/private source responsibility definitions and bridge bytes are identical, so each source decision applies to both scopes. This does not evaluate private native behavior.

actuals.reason: Exact exported immutable Codable/Equatable DTO fields and initializers, typed submission/wireValue, and public View initializer; imports only SwiftUI and uses iOS 14 compatible production APIs. Source-bound public native captures exist; this is not a whole-repository change audit.

Draft initializes no selection, requested count, credit/accepted/sent false; request ID change resets, equal revision preserves edits; @State belongs to the production View and currentDraft reconciles before use.
ForEach keeps caller option order and IDs; selection guards availability, sent and same selected ID, clamps count and clears acceptance.
Native minus/plus have valid-selection/sent/bound checks; changes are exactly -1/+1 and clear acceptance; selected and revised bounds clamp inclusive count.

Current option integer price times count minus current prepaid minus current credit is signed Int arithmetic; absolute magnitude money formatter emits ASCII $ with period and two decimals; balance branches distinguish refund/zero/payment.
Credit initially false; enabled for positive credit while unsent independent of selection, edits clear acceptance, and revision reconciliation preserves choice only for positive new credit.
Selection/count/credit/revision edits clear acceptance; native acceptance toggle requires available selected option and unsent, while send also requires acceptance.

Same-ID changed revision uses every current model field, retains only available selection, clamps retained count, clears acceptance/sent, withdraws zero credit; derived draft is immediately used before onChange persists without identity recreation.

Only submit() calls onSubmit. Guard requires unsent, accepted available selection/current balance; it constructs current typed receipt synchronously then sets sent. Every edit and caller reconciliation path is callback silent.

Eight iOS 14 ScaledMetric bases are 12/28/13/18/15/26/16/20; system fonts with required medium/bold/semibold/regular weights are applied across text roles, without a font environment cap. These are source bases, not computed-font measurements.

Vertical non-scrolling VStack flow owns 16pt outer padding, 20pt sections, 12pt cards, 16pt card and 20pt root radii, 8pt inner/option gaps, 10pt note gaps and 16pt footer gaps; text wraps with vertical fixedSize only and has no line limit/fixed text height.

Actual Button labels use choice minHeight 64pt, quantity minWidth/minHeight 44pt, send minHeight 52pt and 16pt horizontal/14pt vertical padding; frames are minima and text can grow vertically. Native control boxes are separately measured.

All palette literals/role wiring match, but the source opts into PlainButtonStyle on unavailable options, quantity buttons and send, while separately choosing disabled roles. In original public captures the full unavailable card and disabled button are attenuated. Combined source-and-original-pixel evidence contradicts the no-whole-row-attenuation source duty; this is not a computed-style inference from constants.

citations.fact: disabled unavailable option image and native option identity
disabled send image and 52pt native box

actuals.reason: Uses native .leading alignments and preserves caller arrays; no forced layout or text direction. Quantity interpolation and integer money/wire formatting preserve ASCII numeric representation.

Unique API identifiers are on production Text/native Button/Toggle targets; option label is exact caller title, selected trait is applied, and no nested clickable option/switch, hidden duplicate UI or style readback is present. Canvas/summary contain children. Actual exported runtime semantics are separately checked.
Bridge JSON-decodes current immutable MenuChangeModel and forwards only typed submission.wireValue; no business arithmetic or local state exists in bridge.
Imports production AlertToast and directly constructs MenuChangeReviewPanel once at stable call site inside AnyView, without .id, clone or state holder.

Exact public data classes and fixed @Composable API are in required package. Imports are existing Compose/Material3 only, no observer/test package or additional dependency. Public source-bound native renders support compilation; no whole-repository delta claim.

remember holds internal MenuReviewDraft; initial fields and different-ID reset match requirements; equal revision returns same draft. Reconciliation runs before rendering and persists in same remember slot.
Caller options.forEach preserves order; ID/availability/sent/same-ID guards protect selection, then count clamps and acceptance clears.
Minus/plus guard available selection, sent and inclusive bound then decrement/increment exactly one, clearing acceptance; selection and reconciliation coerce current count into new bounds.

Integer current price/count, current prepaid and current credit determine signed Int balance. toLong absolute magnitude formatter uses ASCII dollar/period/two decimals; zero/refund/payment branches follow required copy.
Initial false, independently enabled for positive new credit and unsent; setter guards these conditions and clears acceptance; reconciliation forces false for zero new credit.
All relevant edits and revisions clear acceptance. Acceptance requires valid selected option before send; canSend also requires acceptance and unsent.

Production reconciliation handles ID reset and same-ID changed revisions before UI. All render derivations use current model; removed/unavailable selection clears, desired count remains until clamp, withdrawn credit clears, accepted/sent reset, no keyed component recreation.

The only onSubmit invocation is valid send Button action, constructing all six current fields and synchronously emitting before sent=true. Edit/reconciliation callbacks remain silent, and sent guards prevent repeat send.

Native FontFamily.Default TextStyle uses required sp bases and weights throughout: 12 medium,28 bold,13 normal,18 semibold,15 normal/option semibold,26 bold,16 semibold,20 semibold. No density/font-scale cap. These are source declarations, not OS computed-style claims.

Non-scrolling Column owns 16dp padding,20dp sections,20dp root radius; card helper 16dp radius/12dp padding/1dp border; 8dp inner and option gaps,10dp notes,16dp footer. No maxLines, ellipsis, text fixed height or horizontal scrolling; weighted count keeps controls in one Row.

Native Button modifier/padding specify 64dp choice minHeight,44dp quantity minimum width/height,52dp send minHeight,16dp horizontal/14dp vertical send padding; text can grow. Native box result remains a separate atom.

Every exact light/dark palette constant is selected by current MaterialTheme luminance. Canvas, solid summary, notice, selected option border/fill, signed refund ink, native send enabled/disabled fills and unavailable secondary text are explicitly wired; no complete-row opacity modifier.
Native Alignment.Start/TextAlign.Start/Row and caller iteration are used, with no forced direction or array reversal. Quantity, currency and receipt interpolation preserve required ASCII format.

API tags are on actual native Button/Switch/Text or containing summary/canvas; no merged parent leaf for canvas/summary. Option native semantic contentDescription is exact title plus selected state; supporting visual descendants are cleared, with one clickable Button. Switch has only its native target. No hidden duplicate or style readback.
Current fixture fields, options and notes are decoded without derivation, and only typed production submission.wireValue is forwarded.
Imports production types and directly invokes MenuChangeReviewPanel at stable @Composable call site, no clone, keyed recreation or local product state.
